name: libc++
description: LLVM's implementation of the C++ standard library. Built together with libc++abi as part of the same runtimes build; this package is a no-op that only ensures libc++abi is installed.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
